Information

Real-time ERCOT transmission grid map. LMP prices refresh every 15 minutes from the ERCOT Public API.

What is a match?

ERCOT prices energy at ~4,900 named settlement points. Each is matched to a physical substation in OpenStreetMap using name similarity and geographic proximity. High / medium confidence matches are verified by multiple signals. Low confidence is name-only and may be imprecise. Unmatched substations have an OSM location but no ERCOT settlement point assigned.

LMP colour mode

Blue = below median price · Red = above median. Scale is 5th–95th percentile of live prices. Hover any node to see its exact LMP. Dark grey nodes have no price data.

Lines & graph

Solid lines are OSM HV transmission geometry ≥ 115 kV. Dashed lines are inferred bus-to-bus connectivity from endpoint clustering.
